finding: The local public MATTERIX source contains the PBD powder implementation and a balance-tagged IKA asset, but no implemented powder scoop/weigh workflow or scale mass-readout function was found. Neither an independent force-derived original scale nor a semantic inventory-derived original scale is demonstrated by this checkout.

original_code_evidence.supports: Original powder contact/material parameters and configured particle_mass=1e-6kg. This supplies particle physical parameter mass, not a scale readout.
Creates a fixed grid and passes configured particle_mass to the PhysX solid particle set. No container inventory-to-scale or balance force-to-mass readout here.

IKA asset references the balance-heater-stirrer USD, sets object mass1kg, activate_contact_sensors=False, and semantic tag class=balance. An asset label/configured mass is not a measurement implementation.
Available original particle task config only initializes fluid/powder and reserved systems with5s episode length. It does not define scooping, weighing, dose target or scale precision.
Available registered examples cover beakers, particle systems, beaker lift and heat-transfer semantics; no scoop/weigh task config is registered.
Physics contact semantics reads forces and thresholds them into a contact predicate; this is not a weighing output or calibrated force-to-mass scale.
Semantic heat transfer uses configured object mass. This must not be conflated with a container inventory-based weighing implementation.

paper_evidence.supports: Paper describes Fig4 examples including scooping/weighing powder, without a stated0.7g target or10percent spring-balance metric in this passage.
Fig5B red mass-change curve is explicitly a REAL experiment measured using an IKA RET control scale; it does not establish the implementation of a simulated scale.

local_added_measurement_and_thresholds.supports: Our local native study authors the mechanical prismatic spring platform with1000N/m stiffness and80 damping. This is local reconstruction machinery.
Our scale output is independent calibrated gain times tare_z minus platform_z; particle counts are a separate geometric observer.

Explicitly named local_F_gates introduce final receiver mass>=0.7g and independent spring-scale error<=10percent; local text notes failed100-500mg checks. These are our local acceptance conditions, not recovered original-author values.
The key original_F_thresholds preserves the earlier frozen LOCAL F thresholds. The word original in this key does not establish paper provenance.

search_scope_and_limits: Read-only searches covered the locally available matterix_public and matterix_paper Python/config/docs, visible balance USDA text and archived full paper/supplement text. No mass readout or powder-weigh task source was found. This absence is a source-availability limitation, not proof that no such author implementation ever existed or that the original scale used inventory semantics.
acceptance_integrity: No criteria, canonical F status, physics, live experiment, prepared independent audit or raw evidence was changed. Failing frozen local studies remain failing; this source note is not a retroactive relaxation.
